correctness.rationale: Exhaustive projective-line analysis yields precisely 4 vertical and 24 nonvertical bitangents for every characteristic p>=5. Coefficient comparison gives k quadratic and c^12 expressions; Kummer/norm argument proves field degree 16 and normality. Explicit irreducible degree-eight and degree-sixteen orbit-polynomials identify arithmetic orbit sizes. Fourth-power criterion gives exact prime counts, Chebotarev gives densities. Exact symbolic script and direct enumeration for 44 primes independently corroborate; finite enumeration is not substituted for proof. No assertion for p<=3.

value.rationale: The 28-bitangent scheme is a canonical arithmetic invariant of the distinguished order-48 smooth plane quartic. Complete decomposition into Q-orbits, minimal splitting field, all-prime 2/4/28 rationality and the density law provide a natural full classification, addressing arithmetic information absent from the established complex incidence theory. This is not an arbitrary small numerical specialization.
